name: [Negative] 1‑Day Change Feature Removal Across Brokers
description: Users report that the 1‑day change metric, previously available for all broker holdings, has been restricted to INDmoney‑held shares only, causing loss of cross‑broker portfolio visibility and confusion over total gains/losses.

name: [Negative] Loss of 1‑Day Change Cross‑Broker Tracking
description: Users report that the app no longer displays the 1‑day price change for shares and mutual funds held with external brokers, and that sorting or viewing combined portfolio performance has been removed. This feature was a key differentiator for the platform.
